$files = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath 'docs','tests' -Recurse -File | Sort-Object FullName; $files | ForEach-Object { $json = $null; if ($_.Extension -eq '.json') { try { $json = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $_.FullName | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 100 } catch {} }; [pscustomobject]@{ Path = $_.FullName.Substring((Get-Location).Path.Length + 1); Bytes = $_.Length; SHA256 = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $_.FullName).Hash; RequestId = $json.requestId; PlanId = $json.planId; Status = $json.status } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5; 1..14 | ForEach-Object { $p = '.development-os\runs\ENGPLAN-CYCLE-EVT-20260803-001-WS-{0:D2}-result.json' -f $_; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) { $x = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $p | ConvertFrom-Json; [pscustomobject]@{ WorkstreamId=$x.workstreamId; Status=$x.status; VerificationDisposition=$x.verificationDisposition; ImplementationRevision=$x.implementationRevision } } else { [pscustomobject]@{ WorkstreamId=('WS-{0:D2}' -f $_); Status='missing'; VerificationDisposition='missing'; ImplementationRevision=$null } } } | ConvertTo-Json
